Sourdough Wonder Bread Copycat Recipe

Ingredients
Stiff Sweet Starter
15 g sourdough starter
15 g honey
30 g water
60 g bread flour

Tangzhong
35 g bread flour
175 g whole milk

Main Dough
All of the stiff sweet starter from above
All of the tangzhong from above
225 g cold water
75 g honey or sugar
25 g avocado oil
575 g high-protein bread flour
12 g salt
1 tbsp butter for buttering the baked loaf

Instructions
Make the stiff sweet starter: mix 15 g sourdough starter, 15 g honey, 30 g water, and 60 g bread flour until it forms a ball.
Make the tangzhong: mix 35 g bread flour and 175 g whole milk in a microwave-safe bowl.
Mix the dough: combine all of the stiff sweet starter, all of the tangzhong, 225 g cold water, 75 g honey, 25 g avocado oil, 575 g high-protein bread flour, and 12 g salt.
Bake: preheat oven to 350F. Bake uncovered 40-45 minutes.
